summary: Druid is an open-source analytics data store designed for distributed, column-oriented workloads that require real-time data ingestion and querying. It is written in Java and licensed under the Apache-2.0 licence. The software is built to handle large volumes of event data while maintaining low latency on analytical queries.
goodFor: It suits large-scale operational analytics use cases where high-concurrency ingestion and sub-second query performance on massive datasets are mandatory.
watchOut: Operating a distributed data store of this complexity introduces significant infrastructure overhead and operational maintenance compared to traditional relational databases.
deployNotes: Because it relies on Java and Docker, you will typically need to allocate dedicated memory and configure persistent storage volumes for your container orchestration setup.
